title: Jonah and the Terminal
author: Zephyrine Lockridge
blurb: Rosalind Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
